title: Manchester, Connecticut schools investigate data breach found through a TikTok video
date_note: The page gives only its publication day (25 November) and says the video circulated 'over the weekend'; no earlier exact day is stated.
geo_basis: district named in the report; city centre
summary: GovTech, republishing the Journal Inquirer, reports that Manchester school officials learned of a data breach from a TikTok video that circulated over the weekend and showed someone accessing files. According to a Sunday-evening letter from Superintendent Matt Geary, the affected file server was disconnected from the rest of the network and the district is working with law enforcement to determine the extent of the breach.
plain: Manchester school officials say a TikTok video showed someone accessing files. The superintendent's letter says the affected server was disconnected and law enforcement is helping assess how much was exposed.
exec: A school district learned of a breach from social media; per the superintendent's letter, the extent is still being determined with law enforcement.

validation.note: Only GovTech (relaying the Journal Inquirer) was read; the superintendent's letter itself was not read. The page gives no figures.
